dispositionReason: Captured unverified. It is the source behind the lithium sheet's steady-state interval, monitoring panel and interacting classes, and the Factsheets draft cites it as STAGED DRAFT EVIDENCE. It is not adopted: a 2020 journal article is not a local monitoring protocol, and the citation carries no claim of review. Adoption needs the owner's sign-off.
notes: doi:10.18773/austprescr.2020.024. Must be read together with its 2020 correction (australian-prescriber-lithium-therapy-interactions-correction), which changes the non-thiazide diuretic statement. Australian Prescriber is registered as a catalogue-identity-only authority; this record reconfirms that identity rather than adding a second one.
